minimum_evidence: Segment/site fits AM&L + AI/PS scope; public/legal screening; no red-line conflicts
rejection_condition: Site outside integrity-risk appetite or sanctions/legal block

minimum_evidence: Client confirms decision rights & data access in principle; baseline data exists (>=24 mo history) or plan to build it
rejection_condition: No baseline data and client unwilling to fund baseline build; performance responsibility requested without control
next_action: Feasibility charter with explicit system boundary

minimum_evidence: Baseline normalised (production, availability, cost, events); controllability matrix filled (Bilfinger-controls/joint/client/external) for every outcome promise; data quality scored; capability evidence (references, competence inventory); transition readiness; value model with uncertainty (P10/P50/P90); integrity red lines listed
approver_role: Group model owner + regional P&L owner + HSEQ/integrity function (roles)
rejection_condition: Any outcome promise whose drivers are >50% client/external-controlled; P10 joint value < 0; baseline noise > expected effect; missing AI/PS risk screening for refining/oil&gas/chemicals

minimum_evidence: Asset register + condition audit sample; contract terms: baseline, normalisation rules, KPI definitions with data lineage, gain-share formula, exit/handback conditions, integrity red lines as binding constraints; legal & HSEQ approvals by humans
approver_role: Legal, HSEQ, finance, regional P&L (roles); per delegation of authority
rejection_condition: Legal/HSEQ non-approval; KPI not measurable independently; end-of-term incentives allow deferral

minimum_evidence: Personnel transfer plan; data access live; baseline frozen & signed; risk register; integrity backlog triage completed
rejection_condition: Baseline not frozen; data feeds missing; critical competence not secured

minimum_evidence: Monthly: measured KPIs vs baseline with uncertainty; integrity debt indicator; competence index; backlog age profile; quarterly independent verification; BTS gap review
rejection_condition: Two consecutive quarters below P10 value path; integrity red-line breach; KPI drift vs production counts (gaming indicator)
next_action: Corrective plan or re-baselining or exit trigger

minimum_evidence: Handback condition audit; residual debt measured vs contract; lessons; re-qualification
rejection_condition: Handback condition below contract; unresolved integrity items
